page.title: Organisation
page.description: Manage who belongs to this organisation, what each role can do, and who you've invited.

create.title: Create an organisation
create.description: Each organisation has its own co-pilots, prospects, calls and members. You'll be its owner and can invite your team.
create.name: Organisation name
create.nameHint: Your teammates will see this name in their invitation.

general.name: Organisation name
general.deleteDescription: Permanently deletes the organisation with all its co-pilots, prospects, calls, recordings and analyses, and removes every member. This cannot be undone.
general.deleteDialogDescription: Type {{name}} to confirm. Everything in this organisation is deleted for all members.
general.confirmAria: Type the organisation name to confirm

invitations.copyFailedHint: Select the link and copy it manually.
invitations.inviteDescription: They get an email with a link that works for 7 days. Anyone can belong to several organisations, so existing CallZen users just accept and switch.
invitations.emptyDescription: Invitations you send appear here so you can resend or revoke them.
invitations.revokeDescription: The link stops working immediately. You can send a new invitation any time.

members.removeDescription: They lose access to this organisation immediately. Calls they made stay in the organisation. They can be invited again later.

roles.ownersOnlyEdit: Only owners can change what each role is allowed to do.
roles.ownerLocked: Owners always have every permission, so this role can't be restricted.

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least {{min}} characters
validation.nameMax: Name must be {{max}} characters or fewer
